correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed G=J(5,2) on the 10 two-subsets of five labels; a disconnected 4-subset is exactly the triangle-plus-complement edge, giving ten 2+3 cross-edge K2,3 facet complements. All 371 faces (including empty) have face-by-cardinality (1,10,45,110,135,60,10). Independent ordered matching on full poset has 179 nonempty matched pairs, one critical 0-cell and eleven critical 3-cells, and the entire 370-node/1320-arrow Hasse digraph is acyclic, proving the integral wedge of 11 S3. Independently evaluated signed simplicial traces for all 120 permutations; H3 character on S5 conjugacy types is (11,-1,3,-1,-1,-1,1). Inspecting the pinned exact alternant character routine yields irreducible multiplicities one for (3,2),(2,2,1),(1^5), with dimension 5+5+1=11. Pure 5-dimensional with nonzero H3 implies non-shellable, since pure shellable complexes have reduced homology only in top degree. No equivariant homotopy equivalence or integral lattice theorem claimed.
residual_risks: Finite exhaustive proof is for five labels only; the integral Specht lattice is not classified.
